feature: Bounded flat-directory dictionary discovery and persisted reader chooser
checks: Sorted regular .ifo discovery ignores nested directories and symlinks
Missing directory gives an empty list; 32 choices accepted and the next rejected
Root chooser changes lookup output while preserving other reader state
Selected filename persists through host JSON and device journal reopen
Fresh UI restores the saved available dictionary
Unavailable preference falls back to first sorted choice without rewriting preference
Duplicate configuration rejected without replacing active selection
Simulator directory option and compiled Picco discovery/fallback integration

firmware.installation_status: No automatic installer. Verify the actual device partition table and recovery backup before installation.

limits: Flat directory only; nested packages and duplicate base names across directories are not supported.
4096-entry scan rejection and all filename-length boundary cases are not separately tested here.
Discovery is synchronous at startup; no hot rescan or physical SD performance proof.
Native chooser input, physical hardware, independent tailnet, grayscale and clean reproducibility not rerun.
One optional upstream corpus test remains ignored in the normal gate.
